I want to leave my feedback here 💚 for the fantastic experience I've had at this store. I visit the store regularly and, on every occasion, the service has been exemplary, professional, and always with a genuine smile. I want to highlight Carolina's work, who demonstrates enormous dedication and passion for animals 🐶🐱 — always ready to help with useful advice, suggestions tailored to the type of animal, and with true patience and kindness towards all customers.

The store has a huge variety of products, from food to toys and accessories, many of them of excellent quality and with options for different needs.

The personalized service makes all the difference — we feel like we are really being helped by someone who knows what they are talking about and who loves animals.

Thank you, Carolina, for your support and professionalism! 🙌

I recommend this store wholeheartedly to all pet owners in Lisbon and beyond 🐾💚.

I went to the store in the Acqua Roma shopping center, Areeiro, Lisbon, to buy a box of Félix wet food, 44 sachets. There was a sign on the door saying the food was 25% off (final price €13.49). I went in, found the product, and when I went to pay, the employee said that that particular store wasn't part of the offer and that the price was €17.99. The explanation wasn't convincing, and I didn't buy it. The sign on the door was there. The product was available, and the store didn't honor its promise. Lamentable.
